notes: Single source of truth for feature completion. Coding agents may ONLY edit the 'passes' field. Never remove, rename, or edit a feature's description, category, or steps. Features are grouped by milestone (M0-M8). Work the lowest-numbered feature with passes:false in the current milestone, one at a time. Every pass requires end-to-end verification on a physical Pixel 9.

features.description: Android project created with Kotlin + Compose BOM, min SDK 31, target SDK 35
steps: Create Android Studio project 'DynamicIsland' with package com.jeet.island
Set compileSdk=35, minSdk=31, targetSdk=35 in app/build.gradle.kts
Add androidx.compose BOM 2024.09.00+ with ui, material3, foundation, animation
Add androidx.datastore:datastore-preferences
Run ./gradlew assembleDebug; verify APK builds without errors

features.description: AndroidManifest declares all 6 required permissions
steps: Add SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW permission
Add BIND_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SERVICE permission
Add FOREGROUND_SERVICE and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE permissions
Add POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission
Add READ_PHONE_STATE and SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM permissions
Rebuild; verify permissions appear in the APK's AndroidManifest via aapt dump permissions

features.description: Theme sets windowLayoutInDisplayCutoutMode to shortEdges
steps: In res/values/themes.xml add <item name="android:windowLayoutInDisplayCutoutMode">shortEdges</item>
Apply theme to the application tag
Install APK on Pixel 9, open MainActivity, verify status bar extends into cutout area

features.description: MainActivity shows a Compose permission flow for all 6 permissions
steps: Build Compose UI listing each permission with current grant status
Each row has a 'Grant' button that opens the correct system settings page
SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW uses Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_OVERLAY_PERMISSION
Notification Listener uses Settings.ACTION_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SETTINGS
Install on Pixel 9, verify tapping each row opens the correct system screen

features.description: Permission state refreshes on activity resume
steps: Hook ON_RESUME lifecycle event to re-check all permission grants
Grant SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW in settings, return to app
Verify the row updates to 'Granted' without needing a restart

features.description: IslandService skeleton starts as foreground service of type specialUse
steps: Create IslandService : Service with onStartCommand returning START_STICKY
Call startForeground with a silent persistent notification (channel 'island_service')
In manifest, declare android:foregroundServiceType="specialUse" and android:name attribute
Add property <property android:name="android.app.PROPERTY_SPECIAL_USE_FGS_SUBTYPE" android:value="camera cutout overlay" />
Start service from MainActivity after all permissions granted; verify service appears in Developer Options > Running services

features.description: CutoutResolver reads DisplayCutout from current window metrics
steps: Create src/main/java/com/jeet/island/cutout/CutoutResolver.kt
Implement fun resolve(context: Context): CutoutGeometry? reading windowManager.currentWindowMetrics.windowInsets.displayCutout
Return CutoutGeometry(centerX, topY, width, height, path) with path from cutoutPath on API 31+
Log the geometry to logcat on service start
Install on Pixel 9, verify logcat shows a non-null geometry with centerX near screen midpoint

features.description: Fallback to boundingRects when cutoutPath is null (API 28-30 safety)
steps: In CutoutResolver, if displayCutout.cutoutPath == null use boundingRects[0]
Derive geometry from the rect's centroid and dimensions
Simulate the fallback by null-coalescing path in a debug flag; verify geometry still computes correctly

features.description: Overlay window attached via WindowManager with TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY
steps: In IslandService.onCreate, create WindowManager.LayoutParams with type=TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY, flags=FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE|FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN|FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS, format=TRANSLUCENT
Set gravity=TOP|CENTER_HORIZONTAL
Compute y = cutoutGeometry.topY - padding
Attach a ComposeView as the overlay root
Install, grant SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW, start service; verify no crash and window appears in dumpsys window

features.description: Android 15 overlay order enforced: overlay shown before startForegroundService
steps: In MainActivity, order calls: addView(overlayView, params) FIRST, then startForegroundService(serviceIntent)
Verify ForegroundServiceStartNotAllowedException does NOT occur on Pixel 9 running Android 15
Reversed order should throw; confirm by temporary debug swap

features.description: PillShape composable renders a black capsule at resting size (126dp x 37dp)
steps: Create PillShape composable using Box with RoundedCornerShape(50%)
Fill with Color.Black (opaque for first draft)
Default size: 126.dp wide, 37.dp tall
Attach to overlay; install and view on Pixel 9
Screenshot the device, verify pill is centered horizontally and hugs the camera hole with no visible gap

features.description: Pill repositions on configuration change (rotation)
steps: Listen for ComponentCallbacks2.onConfigurationChanged in the service
Re-run CutoutResolver.resolve and update WindowManager layout params
Rotate phone to landscape and back
Confirm pill either repositions correctly to new cutout location or hides cleanly (acceptable either way); no half-off-screen states

features.description: Pill expands to a target size on tap with spring animation
steps: Add clickable modifier to the pill
Toggle a state: PillSize.Resting (126x37) <-> PillSize.Expanded (280x80)
Use animateDpAsState with spring(dampingRatio=0.75f, stiffness=400f) for both width and height
Install on Pixel 9, tap the pill 10 times, verify spring feels snappy with slight overshoot each time

features.description: Corner radius stays at height/2 throughout the morph for perfect capsule
steps: Derive corner radius dynamically from the animated height value
RoundedCornerShape((animatedHeight.value / 2f).dp)
Visually verify during a 10-tap sequence that no frame shows a square-cornered pill

features.description: Content fades + scales with AnimatedContent during state change
steps: Wrap the pill's inner slot in AnimatedContent
Transition spec: fadeIn + scaleIn(initialScale=0.95f) togetherWith fadeOut + scaleOut(targetScale=0.95f)
Toggle between an empty inner (resting) and a sample Text 'Hello Island' (expanded)
Verify text pops in with the squeeze pulse described in spec Section 4

features.description: NotifListener service receives StatusBarNotifications
steps: Create NotifListener : NotificationListenerService
Register in manifest with BIND_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SERVICE permission and the notification listener intent filter
Override onNotificationPosted; log package, title, text to logcat
Grant Notification Access, send yourself a WhatsApp message
Verify logcat shows the notification details

features.description: IslandStateMachine transitions IDLE -> EXPANDED_NOTIF on notification
steps: Create IslandStateMachine with StateFlow<IslandState>
States: Idle, ExpandedNotif(packageName, title, text, icon)
NotifListener posts to a shared Flow; state machine collects and transitions
Verify by observing state in a logcat tap: new notification -> state flips to ExpandedNotif

features.description: ExpandedNotif auto-collapses to Idle after 3 seconds
steps: On entering ExpandedNotif, launch a coroutine that delays 3000ms then transitions to Idle
If a new notification arrives mid-timeout, reset the timer
Install, send 3 notifications spaced 1 second apart; verify pill stays expanded through all three, collapses 3s after the last

features.description: NotifContent composable renders app icon + title + one-line text
steps: Create ui/states/NotifContent.kt
Horizontal row: app icon (24dp), title (truncate to 1 line, bold), text (truncate to 1 line, regular)
Load app icon via PackageManager.getApplicationIcon
Send a WhatsApp notification; verify icon loads, sender shows as title, preview as text, all on one line

features.description: MediaSessionWatcher reads active sessions via MediaSessionManager
steps: Create MediaSessionWatcher using MediaSessionManager.getActiveSessions (requires notification listener permission)
Register OnActiveSessionsChangedListener
For each active controller, read metadata (title, artist, album art) and playback state
Expose a StateFlow<MediaState?>
Start Spotify playing a song; verify StateFlow emits the correct title + artist

features.description: Media state transitions to EXPANDED_MEDIA and persists while playing
steps: Extend state machine: IslandState.ExpandedMedia(title, artist, albumArt, isPlaying, position, duration)
Transition from Idle on first non-null MediaState
Do NOT auto-collapse while playback state is PLAYING or PAUSED
Return to Idle only when the session stops / is released

features.description: MediaContent composable shows album art, title, artist, play/pause button
steps: Create ui/states/MediaContent.kt
Add Coil image loader dependency
Layout: album art (40dp rounded corners) on left, title+artist stacked center, play/pause icon button on right
Tap play/pause invokes controller.transportControls.play() / .pause()
Verify on Pixel 9 with Spotify: pill shows art + metadata, tapping pause stops Spotify, tapping again resumes

features.description: Waveform scrubber animates with playback position
steps: Draw a thin progress bar below the title/artist row
Width proportional to position / duration
Update at 500ms intervals via a ticker Flow while playing
Verify bar advances smoothly during a song and matches Spotify's position

features.description: TimerService holds TimerState in StateFlow
steps: Create TimerService with StateFlow<TimerState>
TimerState: Idle | Running(endTimeMillis) | Finished
Expose startTimer(durationMillis) and cancelTimer()
Smoke test from an in-app button: start 10s timer, verify StateFlow emits Running, then Finished at ~10s

features.description: AlarmManager setExactAndAllowWhileIdle fires the terminal event
steps: On startTimer, call AlarmManager.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle for the end time
Broadcast receiver on fire transitions state to Finished and vibrates/plays sound
Start a 60s timer, lock the phone, wait; verify fire happens on time even with Doze

features.description: TimerContent composable draws a depleting countdown arc
steps: Create ui/states/TimerContent.kt
Draw a Canvas arc that depletes from 360 to 0 degrees as time progresses
Center shows mm:ss remaining
Verify on Pixel 9: start 2-minute timer, watch arc deplete and digits countdown in real time

features.description: Timer finish triggers a scale-pulse animation + sound
steps: On transition to Finished, run a scale animation (1.0 -> 1.08 -> 1.0) with spring, repeated 3 times
Play a short bell sound via SoundPool
Start a 5s timer; verify pulse + sound at zero

features.description: TelephonyCallback registers for CALL_STATE on API 31+
steps: Register TelephonyCallback via TelephonyManager.registerTelephonyCallback
Implement CallStateListener.onCallStateChanged
Transition state machine to ExpandedCall(number) on RINGING
Transition back to Idle on IDLE
Call the phone from another device; verify state transitions logged in logcat

features.description: CallContent shows caller + Answer/Decline buttons
steps: Create ui/states/CallContent.kt
Resolve caller name via ContactsContract (fallback to phone number)
Answer and Decline buttons invoke TelecomManager.acceptRingingCall and endCall
Verify on Pixel 9: incoming call expands pill, tap Decline hangs up

features.description: ACTION_POWER_CONNECTED broadcast triggers a one-shot pulse
steps: Register BroadcastReceiver for Intent.ACTION_POWER_CONNECTED and ACTION_POWER_DISCONNECTED
On connected: read BatteryManager level, transition state to ChargingPulse(level) for 2 seconds
Show '% charged' briefly inside the pill
Plug and unplug charger on Pixel 9; verify pill pulses and shows battery percent

features.description: GlassSettings data class and DataStore wiring
steps: Create GlassSettings(glassOpacity, borderAlpha, highlightStrength, noiseAmount, tintHue, cornerSmoothing, glassEnabled)
Define Preferences keys and read/write functions in a GlassSettingsStore object
Expose a StateFlow<GlassSettings> that the overlay observes
Write defaults from spec Section 12 on first launch; verify Preferences file created at app's datastore dir

features.description: PillShape renders with semi-transparent black + border + top highlight
steps: In PillShape, apply background = Color.Black.copy(alpha = settings.glassOpacity)
Add border of Color.White.copy(alpha = settings.borderAlpha), 1.dp
Overlay a top-edge Brush.verticalGradient (Color.White at settings.highlightStrength * 0.3f -> transparent)
Verify at defaults (opacity 0.55, border 0.10, highlight 0.60): pill reads as glassy, not pure black

features.description: Noise texture overlay driven by noiseAmount
steps: Generate a 32x32 noise bitmap once at startup
Overlay via drawBehind with alpha = settings.noiseAmount
Verify at noiseAmount=0.03: faint grain visible on close inspection
Verify at noiseAmount=0.0: no grain

features.description: Settings Compose screen with 6 live sliders
steps: Create ui/settings/SettingsScreen.kt
Sliders for: glassOpacity (0.30-0.85), borderAlpha (0-0.20), highlightStrength (0-1.0), noiseAmount (0-0.10), tintHue (0-360), cornerSmoothing (0-1)
Each slider writes to DataStore on change
A mini preview pill at the top of the screen reskins live
Verify on Pixel 9: dragging opacity reskins both preview AND the actual overlay in real time

features.description: Four preset chips (Classic Black / Frosted / Crystal / Smoke)
steps: Row of chips above the sliders
Classic Black: opacity 1.0, border 0, highlight 0, noise 0, tintHue 0
Frosted: defaults from spec Section 12
Crystal: opacity 0.35, border 0.18, highlight 0.9, noise 0.02
Smoke: opacity 0.75, border 0.05, highlight 0.3, noise 0, tintHue 30
Tap a chip; verify all sliders snap to preset values AND overlay reskins

features.description: Glass toggle at top disables all glass effects (reverts to Classic Black)
steps: Add Switch at top of SettingsScreen bound to settings.glassEnabled
When off, PillShape ignores all other glass settings and uses opaque black
Toggle off; verify pill becomes pure black regardless of slider positions
Toggle on; verify current slider values re-apply

features.description: Settings persist across app restart and device reboot
steps: Change opacity to 0.75
Force-stop the app, relaunch
Verify opacity is still 0.75
Reboot the Pixel 9, re-grant overlay permission if needed
Verify opacity still 0.75

features.description: Split state resolves concurrent Timer + Media into two capsules
steps: Add IslandState.Split(leading: InnerState, trailing: InnerState)
State machine detects when both TimerService (Running) and MediaSessionWatcher (ExpandedMedia) are active
Transition to Split with timer on leading, media on trailing
Verify: start Spotify, start 2-minute timer; pill splits into two capsules

features.description: Split layout renders two capsules with a visible gap
steps: Create ui/SplitLayout.kt
Row of two capsules centered on the cutout, with 8dp gap
Leading capsule is wider (shows media), trailing is narrower (timer digits)
Verify visually on Pixel 9: no overlap, gap aligned, both capsules hug the cutout line

features.description: Priority override: incoming call collapses Split, call UI takes over
steps: In state machine, Call state has highest priority
When Call RINGING arrives during Split, transition to ExpandedCall
On call end, restore Split (or whichever states are still active)
Verify by starting timer + media, then calling the phone; call UI shows, hangs up, split restores

features.description: Haptic feedback on tap-to-expand
steps: Call view.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackConstants.CLOCK_TICK) on pill tap
Verify a short tick is felt on Pixel 9 taps

features.description: Overlay hides automatically on secure screens (lockscreen, bank apps)
steps: TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY already does this via SurfaceFlinger; verify behavior
Open a banking app that marks its window FLAG_SECURE; confirm pill is hidden
Lock the phone; confirm pill is hidden on lockscreen
Unlock; pill returns

features.description: Battery optimization exemption prompt on first launch
steps: If PowerManager.isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations == false, show a one-time Compose dialog
Dialog explains why and has a button that opens Settings.ACTION_REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS
Dismiss once stored in DataStore so it never shows again
Verify flow on fresh install

features.description: End-to-end: fresh install -> grants -> all 5 states exercised on Pixel 9
steps: Factory-reset-level clean install
Walk the permission flow granting all required permissions
Trigger each state in order: send a notification, play Spotify, start a timer, receive a call, plug charger
Record a screen video showing all 5 state transitions
Verify no crashes, no stuck states, no mis-positioned pills

features.description: Overnight soak test: service survives 8 hours idle
steps: Install, grant permissions, start service
Lock phone and leave for 8+ hours (overnight)
In the morning, send a notification; verify pill still responds
Check Developer Options > Running services: IslandService still listed
Review logcat for any FATAL exceptions during the idle window

features.description: Settings round-trip: all 4 presets apply correctly and persist
steps: For each preset (Classic Black, Frosted, Crystal, Smoke): tap chip, screenshot pill, force-stop app, relaunch, screenshot pill again
Verify both screenshots match for each preset
Verify the 4 presets look visually distinct from each other
